data: simulated game traffic from several worlds
weighting: every world has the same total row weight in the loss; its history variants share it

selection.criterion: worst held-out world PR-AUC, leaving one world out
selection.caveat: the held-out worlds choose the tree count and the candidate, so these numbers are optimistic and are not a test result

input_groups.criterion: a group is dropped when the held-out worlds that carry its inputs score a higher mean PR-AUC without it; a group that no world carries is not checked

policy.chosen_on: pooled out-of-world scores of codes/v5-signals at 125 trees, one seed: each world scored by the model trained without it; the same number of rows is drawn from every world
